correctness.rationale: Exact path decomposition gives H=pz+qzH^2, F=p(1-epsilon)z/(2-H)+qzH and S_mu(z)=[1-p epsilon z Phi(H)/(1-F)]/(1-z). On 4q=p(2-epsilon)^2, direct symbolic expansion gives F=1-h t/[2(h-1)]+O(t^2), t=sqrt(1-(z/R)^2). The removable z=1 point, non-dominant -R branch, aperiodic unique pole on |z|=R, and initial exponential-moment analytic extension justify transfer to the exact amplitude. Symbolic identities, exact rational return coefficients and finite Markov propagation were checked; they do not substitute for the infinite-time proof.

originality.rationale: The source paper derives the model and renewal function but explicitly defers the R-null collision (its equation (27), discussion after); the present theorem determines the previously unspecified critical survival prefactor for a class of initial distributions including physical Lebesgue initial data. value.rationale: At the source's explicitly underexplored R-null collision, the exact critical survival amplitude for a natural family of initial data is a quantitatively meaningful asymptotic invariant beyond the exponential escape rate. The simple physical Lebesgue factor 2 sqrt(2/pi)/epsilon and the dependence on the initial generating function distinguish initial-condition classes. This resolves a motivated model-specific quantitative gap despite relying on standard analytic transfer machinery.
